extracted.name: Non-alcoholic Irish cream liqueur
extracted.description: Indulge in an Irish cream liqueur, minus the booze. Our non-alcoholic version has all the creamy flavours of the classic cocktail, plus espresso and spices
ingredient_lines: pinch of finely grated orange zest
instruction_lines: Put all the ingredients in a large cocktail shaker or jug with a generous handful of ice.
If using a shaker, shake well until the outside feels cold, then double strain into tumblers. If using a jug, stir well until combined. Serve poured over ice.
